title: Add Shop Management System with Open/Close Toggle

requirements.summary: Add shop status toggle switch at the top of the Admin Dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle switch is prominently displayed at the top of the Admin Dashboard page
Toggle shows clear visual distinction between ON (Open) and OFF (Closed) states
Toggle state persists after page refresh
Toggle is only accessible to authenticated admin users

file_operations.description: Create a shop status toggle component that displays the current shop open/closed status with a switch control. Use the shadcn/ui Switch component for the toggle. Call backend method getShopOpenStatus() to fetch current status and setShopOpenStatus(boolean) to update it. Show clear labels for 'Open' (green indicator) and 'Closed' (red indicator) states. Include loading state while fetching or updating status. Use React Query mutation for status updates with optimistic updates and automatic query invalidation.

Add React Query hooks for shop status management. Create useGetShopOpenStatus query hook that calls actor.getShopOpenStatus() with queryKey ['shopStatus']. Create useSetShopOpenStatus mutation hook that calls actor.setShopOpenStatus(status) and invalidates ['shopStatus'] query on success. Export both hooks for use in components.

Import and render the ShopStatusToggle component at the top of the admin dashboard page, above the existing tabs. Position it prominently with appropriate spacing and styling to make it easily visible and accessible to admin users. Ensure it's rendered within the AdminGuard protection.

requirements.summary: Display full-width notice banner on home screen when shop is closed
acceptanceCriteria: Banner appears at the top of the home screen when shop is closed
Banner displays the exact text specified
Banner uses a soft orange or grey background color
Banner is full-width and professionally styled
Banner disappears when shop is open

file_operations.description: Create a full-width notice banner component that displays when the shop is closed. Use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to check shop status. When shopOpen is false, render a banner with the exact text: 'Namaste! MBG Store is currently Closed. We are not accepting orders right now. We will open again at 8:00 AM. Thank you for your patience!' Style with a soft orange background (use bg-orange-100 or similar Tailwind class), full width (w-full), padding, centered text, and professional typography. Use shadcn/ui Alert component for consistent styling. Return null when shop is open or while loading.
Import and render the ShopClosedBanner component at the very top of the HomePage, before the store banner image. This ensures the notice is the first thing customers see when the shop is closed.

requirements.summary: Disable 'Add to Cart' and 'Checkout' buttons when shop is closed
acceptanceCriteria: All 'Add to Cart' buttons in ProductCard components are disabled when shop is closed
Checkout button in CartDrawer is disabled when shop is closed
Disabled buttons show visual indication (greyed out or similar)
Buttons function normally when shop is open

file_operations.description: Import and use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to check shop status. Disable the 'Add to Cart' button when shopOpen is false by setting the disabled prop and adding visual styling (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed). Add a title/tooltip attribute explaining why the button is disabled when shop is closed. Ensure the button functions normally when shopOpen is true.

Import and use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to check shop status. Disable the checkout/proceed button when shopOpen is false. Show a brief message near the button explaining that checkout is unavailable because the shop is closed. Apply disabled styling (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) and prevent navigation to checkout page when disabled.

requirements.summary: Add colored dot indicator next to store name in header showing shop status
acceptanceCriteria: Green dot appears next to store name when shop is open
Red dot appears next to store name when shop is closed
Indicator is visible on all pages with the header
Dot has a small, unobtrusive size but is clearly visible
Status updates in real-time when shop status changes

file_operations.description: Import and use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to fetch current shop status. Add a small colored dot indicator next to the store name/logo. When shopOpen is true, show a green dot (bg-green-500). When shopOpen is false, show a red dot (bg-red-500). Style the dot as a small circle (w-2 h-2 or w-3 h-3, rounded-full) positioned inline with the store name. Include a subtle animation or glow effect for better visibility. Add a title attribute for accessibility (e.g., 'Shop Open' or 'Shop Closed').

requirements.summary: Show popup notification during checkout if shop closes while customer has items in cart
acceptanceCriteria: Popup appears on the checkout page if shop status changes to closed
Popup displays the exact message specified
Popup prevents order submission until dismissed
User can dismiss the popup and return to cart or home
Popup does not appear if shop was already closed when user navigated to checkout

file_operations.description: Create a dialog component using shadcn/ui Dialog or AlertDialog that displays when the shop closes while on the checkout page. Show the exact message: 'Sorry, the store just closed. Please place your order when we reopen!' Include buttons to either go back to the cart or return to the home page. Use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to monitor shop status. Style with appropriate warning/alert colors and ensure it's modal (blocks interaction with checkout form until dismissed).

Import and integrate the ShopClosedCheckoutDialog component. Use the useGetShopOpenStatus hook to monitor shop status continuously while on the checkout page. Track whether shop was open when the page loaded (using useRef or useState). If shop status changes from open to closed during the user's session on checkout page, show the dialog. Disable the place order button and form submission when shop is closed. Ensure the dialog only appears if the shop status actually changed (not if it was already closed when user navigated to checkout).
